operations.title: Entry 1270 — The Asymmetric Five-Site Canonical Function Has a Degree-Sixteen 13304-Term Numerator
operations.body: The source-authorized 180-term Eq.33 sum was compiled exactly on the asymmetric slice. Omega=N16/product(q_a), with 26 labelled linear factors, degree(N16)=16, and 13,304 monomials. Exact division shows none of the 26 carrier factors divides N16, so every frozen wall survives the canonical sum.

operations.title: Benincasa compiles the exact asymmetric five-site canonical function
operations.body: Entry 1270: the 180 source terms compile exactly to N16 over all 26 labelled factors. N16 has 13,304 monomials (387,020 serialized chars), and no carrier factor cancels by exact division. The corrected integrated problem now has a durable exact coefficient input. Next is pullback to the three-variable 32-sheet Kummer cover and a finite generic twisted de Rham/Jacobian rank test.
